text_block_list.text:
Early morning, before the sun had even 
fully risen. Having woken up and unable to 
get back to sleep, I was taking a stroll 
when—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Huh. Are you a Trainer from the 
academy? What are you doing here so early?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
A walk! It was such a wonderful night, 
after all.
choice_data_list:
Wasn't being out at this hour against 
school rules?

Wasn't being out at this hour against 
school rules?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Well, that is true, but still.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I honestly intended to head right back 
home at first. Just get a breath of night 
air and go straight to bed.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Still... along this road, the streetlights 
stretched on into the distance, you know? 
They were just like guideposts.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
And so, I wondered what would happen if I 
just kept walking and walking this path 
forever.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
From then on, I walked while counting the 
lights. It was pretty. The sky was wide 
and quiet.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps a meteor shower was passing 
through. I could see countless shooting 
stars falling over the darkened town. And 
as I watchedââ

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
My tummy started rumbling! My claws were 
hurting too, and it was already morning! 
So when I came back, you caught me 
red-handed! Ahaha!
choice_data_list: Does that mean all night long!?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Keep it a secret, okay? Getting scolded is 
so dreadfully boring.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, more importantly, I really need to 
eat breakfast soon.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh, why not join in too? Since fate 
brought us together, let me hear your 
story as well.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
At the family restaurant over that way. 
The egg over rice on their breakfast menu 
is delicious.
choice_data_list: Persuade her to go home and rest.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"You should just go home and sleep"? Man, 
you sound just like Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Just the other day, I went to school after 
pulling an all-nighter and got lectured in 
the student council room for almost an 
hourâ

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Urrgh, that flat, deadpan tone gets me 
every time. Just thinking about it makes 
me... *yaaawn*...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... I'll just sleep over there... Good 
night.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeah, then follow me!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—Haha, couldn't sleep so you went for a 
walk? Sounds like you're in for a sleepy 
day too, then.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Even so, once my stomach is full and warm, 
the drowsiness really creeps in...
